covers: Baseline. A clean five-column grid with plain canonical headings and no labels, nesting or ambiguity. If this document does not score 100% nothing else in the set is interpretable.

slides.title: Riverbend Youth Collective — Summer Bridge Logic Model

columns.heading: RESOURCES
items: Two full-time program coordinators based at the Riverbend site
Annual operating grant from the Halloway Foundation
Donated classroom space at Riverbend Community Centre
A volunteer roster of thirty trained reading mentors

columns.heading: ACTIVITIES
items: Six-week summer literacy intensive for rising fourth graders
Weekly one-to-one mentoring pairings throughout the term
Monthly family literacy evenings held at the community centre
Quarterly professional development for volunteer mentors

columns.heading: OUTPUTS
items: One hundred and twenty rising fourth graders enrolled each summer
Two thousand four hundred mentoring contact hours delivered
Eight family literacy evenings hosted across the year
Thirty volunteer mentors completing the full training sequence

columns.heading: SHORT-TERM OUTCOMES
items: Participants read aloud with visibly greater fluency by August
Families report knowing which books suit their child's level
Mentors describe themselves as confident leading a session

columns.heading: LONG-TERM OUTCOMES
items: Participants enter middle school reading at or above grade level
Riverbend families sustain a habit of reading together at home
